abilities.name: Fight Club Legend

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description:
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.
When the 2nd and 4th strikes hit opponents, Itto will gain 1 and 2 stacks of Superlative Superstrength, respectively.
Max 5 stacks. Triggering this effect will refresh the current duration of any existing stacks.
Additionally, Itto's Normal Attack combo does not immediately reset after sprinting or using his Elemental Skill, "Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!"

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
When holding to perform a Charged Attack, Itto unleashes a series of Arataki Kesagiri slashes without consuming Stamina. Instead, each Arataki Kesagiri slash consumes 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength. When the final stack is consumed, Itto delivers a powerful final slash.
If no stacks of Superlative Superstrength are available, Itto will perform a single Saichimonji Slash.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

_curatorNotes: N hits sourced from gcsim's attackFrames[attack0Stacks] (out-of-stance, no Superlative Superstrength stacks). gcsim has a second slice attackFrames[attack1PlusStacks] used when stacks > 0 — frames differ on cancel-into-charge: N1 C=23, N2 C=27, N3 C=21, N4 C=52 (stack-loaded). Schema cannot represent stack-conditional N→C cancel; reviewer to decide.
N4 has gcsim ActionCharge=500 (marked illegal in gcsim TODO comment); C omitted on N4 per recipe convention for final-in-combo claymore hit.

chargeFrames is the cold-open Saichimonji Slash (Saichi, no stacks) — gcsim's chargeFrames[SaichiSlash], hitmark 89, anim 131. Itto's CA is a 4-state combo (Saichi → Left → Right → Final) gated on Superlative Superstrength stacks with prev/cur-slash windup-frame deltas; the schema's single chargeFrames slot cannot represent the combo. CA1/CAF hitmarks (with stacks): Left=51, Right=24, Final=71. State-conditional windups: NA→CA0 14–21f, NA→CA1/CAF 10f, CA0/CAF→CA1 17f, CA2→CA1 28f, CA0/CAF→CAF 17f, CA1/CA2→CAF 25f. Reviewer to decide representation.

plungeFrames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFrames. gcsim does not set ActionJump on lowPlungeFrames — J omitted per recipe. highPlungeFrames exist (anim 87, hitmark 40) but are not represented per recipe.
Plunge in gcsim is gated on AirborneXianyun (sim limitation), not in-game.

In-stance N (Raging Oni King): same frame slices as base (gcsim does not differ). Differences are: (a) larger hitbox (attackHitboxes[1] vs [0]); (b) stack grants on N1/N3 instead of N2/N4 (q-attack source); (c) Geo infusion via Snapshot override. The in-stance N is authored as a separate `normal` ability with `conditions: state=inStance` + infusion=geo, mirroring frames identically.

Per-character note in recipe-tier-b.md mentions a Saichigiri-after-N3 mechanic (charged-only-at-N3) and C1 +1 skill charge — neither is present in gcsim source. C1 grants 2 Superlative Superstrength stacks, not a skill charge; no chargeModifiers authored. The N3-CA distinction is the standard CA-state machine (Saichi vs stack-CA), not an N3-specific mechanic.

abilities.name: Fight Club Legend (Raging Oni King)
abilities.description: Itto's normal-attack combo while in the Raging Oni King stance. The 4-hit string uses identical frame timings to the base combo, but all hits are converted to Geo DMG (cannot be overridden), gain a +10% ATK SPD buff during normals, and grant Superlative Superstrength stacks on the 1st and 3rd strikes (instead of 2nd/4th).
_curatorNotes: Frames mirror the base normal — gcsim uses the same attackFrames slices in/out of Q stance. The differences are mechanical (hitbox, stack-grant timing, infusion, ATK SPD buff), not frame-level.

Q stance grants +10% ATK SPD on normals (gcsim burstAtkSpdKey, only applies during NormalAttackState) — not authored as a buff effect; reviewer to decide. ATK SPD scales hitmarks at runtime per gcsim, but the schema doesn't encode this for the planner.
Stack-grant change in Q stance: N1 and N3 each grant 1 stack (instead of base N2=1 / N4=2). Mechanical only; no schema impact.

abilities.name: Masatsu Zetsugi: Akaushi Burst!
abilities.description:
Hurls Ushi, the young akaushi bull and auxiliary member of the Arataki Gang, dealing Geo DMG to opponents on hit. When Ushi hits opponents, Arataki Itto gains 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength.

Ushi will remain on the field and provide support in the following ways:
· Taunts surrounding opponents and draws their attacks.
· Inherits HP based on a percentage of Arataki Itto's Max HP.
· When Ushi takes DMG, Arataki Itto gains 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength. Only 1 stack can be gained in this way every 2s.
· Ushi will flee when its HP reaches 0 or its duration ends. It will grant Arataki Itto 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength when it leaves.

Hold
Adjust throwing angle.

Ushi is considered a Geo construct. Arataki Itto can only deploy 1 Ushi on the field at any one time.
_curatorNotes: Ushi is a Geo construct (gcsim construct.GeoConstructIttoSkill). 6s lifetime fixed in gcsim (skill.go: `c.newUshi(6*60, ...)`). spawnsAt=14 = skillRelease (the skill hitmark frame, when the Ushi-spawn callback fires after a successful hit). Ushi grants 1 SSS stack on hit, on damage taken (2s ICD), and on expire/destruction — none authored.
Skill cooldown starts on release per `SetCDWithDelay(action.ActionSkill, 600, skillRelease)`.
Hold variant (adjust throw angle) not authored — gcsim does not differentiate frames; in-game it only re-aims.
Stamina-cost override during Q stance (gcsim ActionStam returns 0 for ActionCharge while Itto has SSS stacks > 0) — Pattern 5 (no animation change), not authored.

abilities.description:
Time to show 'em the might of the Arataki Gang! For a time, Itto lets out his inner Raging Oni King, wielding his Oni King's Kanabou in battle.
This state has the following special properties:
· Converts Itto's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks to Geo DMG. This cannot be overridden.
· Increases Itto's Normal Attack SPD. Also increases his ATK based on his DEF.
· On hit, the 1st and 3rd strikes of his attack combo will each grant Arataki Itto 1 stack of Superlative Superstrength.
· Decreases Itto's Elemental and Physical RES by 20%.

The Raging Oni King state will be cleared when Itto leaves the field.
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the stance lowers his own Elemental and Physical RES by 20% while it lasts.
_curatorNotes: Stance duration = 11s (base game value; matches genshin-db description and the 660-frame base in gcsim's `burstDuration = 660 + 90 + 45 // barely cover basic combo` — the +90+45 frames are gcsim padding to cover combo tail, not actual stance duration). gcsim's burstBuffKey StatMod uses 795 frames (13.25s); reviewer may prefer that value if matching gcsim exactly.
terminatesOnSwap=true: gcsim onExitField subscribes to OnCharacterSwap and deletes burstBuffKey when Itto swaps off-field.

Stance grants: (a) Geo infusion on N/C/P (gcsim Snapshot override, cannot be overridden — see also Snapshot section in itto.go); (b) +10% ATK SPD on normals only (burstAtkSpdKey); (c) ATK += defConv[talent] × TotalDef snapshotted at cast (burstBuffKey StatMod). The DEF→ATK conversion is a scaling buff — no `value` authored on the burst. Per-talent defConv table from gcsim itto_gen.go required for value.

Enemy resShred DELETED (capability sweep 2026-07-28): the -20% RES drop is a SELF debuff on Itto, not an enemy shred — gcsim burst.go:36 kit comment 'Decreases Itto's Elemental and Physical RES by 20%', and burst.go:38-110 contains no enemy ResistMod at all (only self StatMods for DEF→ATK and atk speed). The 2026-05-09 F1 migration note's 'gcsim applies via Snapshot debuff' claim was false. Self RES drop is caveated instead; negative-value self buff effects (allElementalRes/physicalRes -20) intentionally NOT authored — renderer untested for negative buffs (orchestrator call).

Burst frames: ActionAttack/ActionSkill/ActionBurst not explicitly set in gcsim (default to anim=91); N/E omitted per recipe silent-default rule. The intended Q→N/E cancel is 91f if reviewer wants to add it.
C1: 2 SSS stacks at ~75f after Q + 1 stack every 30f for 60–120f (gcsim cons.go c1) — not authored; SSS economy is not represented in the schema.

C2: CD reduction AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (A7b pilot, Nate implement-first): three flat -1.5s cooldownModifiers on the burst, gated constellation:2 + teamElementCount(geo excl-self) >= 0/1/2 — gcsim counts Geo members incl. Itto statically at init (cap 3), and Itto is Geo, so excl-self >= 0/1/2 is exactly equivalent. The 6-energy-per-Geo-member restore (cap 18) stays unauthored: energy generation is out of scope by constitution.

passives.name: Arataki Ichiban
passives.description:
When Arataki Itto uses consecutive Arataki Kesagiri, he obtains the following effects:
· Each slash increases the ATK SPD of the next slash by 10%. Max ATK SPD increase is 30%.
· Increases his resistance to interruption.

These effects will be cleared once he stops performing consecutive slashes.
_curatorNotes: No effects authored. ATK SPD ramp on Kesagiri (CA1/CA2) only, +10% per stack max 30%, only applies during ChargeAttackState (gcsim asc.go a1Update). Resets on Saichi or non-CA action. Schema has no consecutive-slash counter; reviewer to decide whether to model. Interrupt resistance is not modeled.

passives.name: Bloodline of the Crimson Oni
passives.description: Arataki Kesagiri DMG is increased by 35% of Arataki Itto's DEF.
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger on inherited damage entry. gcsim asc.go a4 adds FlatDmg = TotalDef × 0.35 to all charge attacks except Saichi (Left/Right/Final slashes only). Likely `{ type: "onHit", ability: "chargeAttack" }` with a Saichi-exclusion condition the schema can't express. Scaling factor 35 (% of DEF) is correct. Reviewer to wire trigger and exclude Saichi.

constellations.name: Gather 'Round, It's a Brawl!
constellations.description:
After using Royal Descent: Behold, Itto the Evil!, each party member whose Element is Geo will decrease that skill's CD by 1.5s and restore 6 Energy to Arataki Itto.
CD can be decreased by up to 4.5s in this manner. Max 18 Energy can be restored in this manner.
_curatorNotes: Note: description says 'decrease that skill's CD' but the gcsim implementation reduces ActionBurst cooldown (the burst's own CD) — this matches the in-game effect (Q-CD reduction, not E-CD). Reviewer to verify schema-expressible team-comp-conditional CD reductions; not authored.
